digest.component_or_area: code-review project criterion and evaluation framework
propositions: Author a project-owned code-review criterion with four co-located subrules that enforce Pass-1-finder, Pass-2-verifier, Pass-3-decider, and Pass-4-coach phase boundaries and contract compliance.
Implement the criterion as a single-turn Pass-1 finder that emits grounded evidence only, never assesses severity/confidence/impact/policy/remediation, and leaves suggested_fix empty.

Activate the criterion in criteria_routing with advisory routing (exec 1-TURN, block_threshold 0.90, blocking_enabled false) and create a balanced twelve-case eval corpus (RP-F1..F6 must fire, RP-N1..N6 must not fire) with guards for instruction vs. documentation, phase ownership clarity, and unchanged grandfathered debt.

Achieve perfect eval metrics across three live runs: recall 1.0, false_accept 0.0, agreement 1.0, minimum per-case stability ≥2/3, Cohen kappa ≥0.70, with all fires and abstentions matching corpus expectations.

Add project-owned assets only (.rebar files, tests, docs subsection) and verify project placement with a runner-backed test that asserts diff interpolation, valid finding structure, absence of prohibited fields, and metric validation.
Land the criterion commit on main with LLM-Review approval, passing CI, and zero-blast-radius advisory routing before the downstream DD-CRITERION-5 acceptance gate.
